name: Nancy Nathanson

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Nathanson lists her occupation as state representative and her occupational background as library program manager.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: Her statement lists prior governmental experience on the Eugene City Council (1993-2005), the Eugene Planning Commission (1987-1993) and the Lane Council of Governments Board.
bio.excerpt: Eugene City Council, 1993- 2005; Eugene Planning Commission, 1987-1993; Lane Council of Governments Board

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: Her statement lists a University of Oregon BS from 1975.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: Her official legislative page lists her as Democrat, District 13, Eugene.

positions.statement: Nathanson says her legislation halted tax breaks for data centers and that she pushes for protections from artificial intelligence.
positions.excerpt: Her legislation put a halt to tax breaks for data centers.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: She says she led efforts to get alternative care and mobile medical response teams after a hospital closure, and to limit powerful corporate interests.
positions.excerpt: When hospital closure and corporate medicine threatened health care access for thousands of constituents, Nancy led efforts to get alternative care and new mobile medical response teams

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: She says she championed safe sleep sites and tiny homes to reduce homelessness and led efforts to protect renters and mobile home residents.
positions.excerpt: She led efforts to protect renters and mobile home residents

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: She says she championed increased funding for addiction and recovery treatment and school health clinics.
positions.excerpt: Nancy championed increased funding for addiction and recovery treatment and school health clinics.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: She says she led efforts to establish a cybersecurity center to protect Oregonians and add wildfire cameras.
positions.excerpt: She led efforts to establish a cybersecurity center to protect Oregonians and add wildfire cameras

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

gaps: No roll-call votes were listed on her official legislative page, so voting_record is empty.
Her opponent Jonathan T Abrahamsen did not submit a statement, so no side-by-side comparison material exists.
